column5: To identify and register a pregnant woman so that she can proceed to the ANC consultation
column6: Starting point: Woman arrives at clinica » Quick check to ensure the woman does not need urgent medical attention » Query pregnant woman’s health record » Register pregnant woman’s details » Update record with registration information, if needed

column4: » Pregnant woman » ANM or nurse midwife
column5: To counsel and provide ANC services to pregnant woman
column6: Starting point: Woman has been registered and is ready to begin ANC contact » Record health history » Assess danger signs » Assess current pregnancy conditions, including symptoms, physical exam and lab tests » Case management or referral » Schedule follow-up contact » Provide counselling on all health topics necessary (e.g. nutrition, HIV testing, family planning, psychosocial and support services)

column4: » Pregnant woman » ANM or nurse midwife » Referral health-care provider
column5: To provide timely and appropriate referrals to a higher-level facility or health-care provider
column6: Starting point: Woman requires referral » Assess pregnant woman’s danger signs » Stabilize pregnant woman’s condition » Arrange emergency transport » Liaise with next level facility for care upon arrival

column4: » Pregnant woman » ANM or nurse midwife » Community health worker
column5: To provide routine health promotion and follow-up within the community
column6: Starting point: Woman receives community/home-based contact » Visit pregnant woman at home or provide outreach in the community » Conduct basic assessment » Determine referral to facility » Distribute commodities (e.g. iron and folic acid, supplements, condoms for protection against STIs)
